journey.name: Lift: an EMOM heard with the screen off
journey.description: An EMOM keeps counting and beeping each minute while the screen is off, held awake by the timers' service and shown as a Live Update, and lets go once its minutes are up. Starting it over a rest keeps the service going. Run with the emulator's volume up, notifications allowed (lift-rest-alert.xml asks).

actions.action: Tap the "Lift" tab, then "Start session" (or "Resume session")
Tap "Log set" and verify that a rest counts down
Tap "Add set or EMOM" in the title bar, then "An EMOM", set "Minutes" to 3, and tap "Start EMOM"
Verify that the EMOM's screen shows "Get ready" and that the session's rest is gone
Verify with adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact that an ongoing notification titled "EMOM · minute 1 of 3" is showing, with PROMOTED_ONGOING among its flags (Android 16+)
Turn the screen off (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP)
Verify with adb shell dumpsys power that a PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK tagged "interval:timer" is held
Wait about a minute and a half and verify that the minute's beeps 3-2-1 and Start played with the screen off (the emulator's audio, or logcat's AudioTrack lines)
Verify with adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact that the notification is titled "EMOM · minute 2 of 3"
Wait until the EMOM's three minutes are up and verify that its last beep played with the screen off
Wait ten seconds and verify with adb shell dumpsys power that no wake lock tagged "interval:timer" is held, and that the EMOM's notification is gone
Turn the screen on (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP), swipe to unlock, and verify that the session shows again
